title: NativeAgent eval-coverage ledger fragment (one per fence)

fence.description: the fence id this fragment covers, exactly as assigned

surfaces.description: EVERY thing in the fence a user, another module, or a store can observe: public types/functions, settings/switches, UI controls and summaries, stores/feeds written, background loops, tool names, routes, env vars, CLI flags.

id.description: stable dotted id, e.g. chat.toolLoop.maxIterations or ui.DeskView.nagToggle

coverage.description: EXISTING evals that touch it — empty array means UNCOVERED. Evidence required.

ref.description: section id / test name / script path — file:line

silentFailureMode.description: how this breaks WITHOUT anyone noticing (state lifecycle leak, silent zero, dead control, slowdown, wrong value, stale UI)

proposedEval.description: for UNCOVERED or reports-only: the cheapest HONEST eval

reads.description: exactly what store/feed/trace/AX node it would read

asserts.description: the envelope property it asserts (never exact values unless contractual)

ranRun.description: ONE thing you actually executed in this fence (a test filter, a script, a read of a live feed) and what it returned — not a claim

uncertain.description: surfaces you could not classify or could not find evidence for — say so, never guess
